items: Linked tickets reach the task document on every flow. `LINKED_TICKETS` was built from `ticketData.linkedTickets` alone, which only the PR-data path fills, so a dev or fix-bug run rendered no **Linked Tickets** section at all; and the keys an operator adds in Command Center live on `run.linkedTicketRefs`, which the writer never read, so they reached no task document on any flow, PR runs included. The writer now renders the identities `runLinkedTicketsView` already resolves for the UI, so there is one merge rather than two. A recorded URL and title win, then the run's own Jira link, and the project's `jira.base_url` covers a run with neither, through the one browse base `TICKET_URL` already uses; with no base the key stays unlinked rather than inventing a host. The resolver also answers which refs the run actually names — its fetched key, a recorded linked ticket or an operator's addition — because a backlog run's `MANUAL-000124` matches the Jira key shape, and linking it from `ticketOrPr` alone would publish a dead browse URL while `TICKET_URL` stayed empty for the same run. An operator key added after the task is written does not reach that worker; it reaches the next task written for the run. A worker asked to link every ticket in the PR body can now see them

A comparison dev or fix-bug run with a `startRef` on a project that declares `artifact_check` or `prepare.pinned_profiles` now prepares a build of its start commit or fails before its worker starts. Prepare selects strictly from `pinned_profiles`, passes the resolved commit to preflight as `FARMSLOT_PREPARE_BASE_SHA` and requires the preflight's `prepare-artifact.json` receipt; a refusal's reason is the prepare error. The installed build is recorded on `run.prepareArtifact` (returned by `run.get` and copied to the run episode); dispatch, restart recovery and `skipPrepare` refuse a pinned run without it, and a replay that would re-dispatch restarts from prepare. Capsule and proof trials record the Runway build their slot reports, unenforced, so analysis can filter mismatched cells

Publication gates compare a selected recipe attempt with the package head even when the review snapshot has none, so a state-only (transcript) attempt recorded on another or dirty commit is refused, as captures already are

A prepare profile can require `required_skills_present`, so a profile that skips the `deps` phase falls back to one that runs it when a skill the pack's `required_skills` names is missing from the checkout. Release clears the farm-owned paths that hold installed skills and `deps` restores them, so an `attach` dispatch could otherwise reach task init with the skill gone and be refused before dispatch ("Refresh the slot skills, then prepare again.")

Run traces (ADR-039 Amendment 10): agent sessions are archived as each ends (worker completion, each review round, each review fix, before a replay, and on `bundle retain`), per session and atomically, with slot release as the backstop; `traces.enabled: false` opts a project out
